assistant|cocktail_recipe_pimms_cup_twis: Pimm's Cup with a Twist: 1.5 oz Hendrick's gin, 0.5 oz lemon juice, 0.5 oz simple syrup, 0.5 oz Pimm's No. 1, splash of ginger beer
assistant|cocktail_recipe_cucumber_gimle: Cucumber Gimlet: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1 oz lime juice, 0.5 oz simple syrup, 0.5 oz cucumber juice
assistant|cocktail_recipe_rose_petal_spr: Rose Petal Spritz: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 2 oz Prosecco, 1 oz rose syrup, 1 oz lemon-lime soda
assistant|cocktail_recipe_gin_gin_mule: Gin-Gin Mule: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 4 oz ginger beer, squeeze of lime juice
assistant|cocktail_recipe_summer_solstic: Summer Solstice: 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1 oz peach puree, 1 oz lemon juice, 0.5 oz honey syrup
assistant|cocktail_recipe_hendricks_high: Hendrick's High Tea: 1 oz steeped tea, 2 oz Hendrick's gin, 1 oz lemon juice, 0.5 oz honey syrup
assistant|simple_syrup_recipe: Classic simple syrup: 1 cup sugar dissolved in 1 cup water, heated and cooled
assistant|simple_syrup_storage: Simple syrup can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks
assistant|syrup_variation_cucumber: Cucumber simple syrup: add sliced cucumbers while cooling, infuse at least 30 minutes
assistant|syrup_variation_mint: Mint simple syrup: add fresh mint sprigs while cooling for a minty twist
assistant|syrup_variation_lemon: Lemon simple syrup: add a slice of lemon while cooling for a brighter citrusy flavor
assistant|citrus_syrup_recommendation_gr: Recommended grapefruit simple syrup: bitterness balances Pimm's sweetness, citrus enhances Hendrick's botanicals
assistant|citrus_syrup_recommendation_le: Recommended lemon-ginger simple syrup: adds warmth and spice, ginger complements Hendrick's spicy notes
assistant|citrus_syrup_recommendation_or: Recommended orange-blossom simple syrup: floral fragrance complements rose and cucumber notes in Hendrick's
assistant|grapefruit_variety_ruby_red: Ruby Red Grapefruit: deep red color, sweet-tart flavor, gives syrup a pink hue and balanced flavor
assistant|grapefruit_variety_white: White Grapefruit ("White Lady"): pale yellow skin, tart and slightly sweet, more pronounced bitterness
assistant|grapefruit_variety_pink: Pink Grapefruit: sweet tangy flavor and pink color, yields a sweeter, more flavorful syrup
assistant|garnish_recommendations: Recommended garnishes: cucumber slice/wheel, grapefruit slice, mint sprig, edible flowers, fresh fruit
assistant|drink_presentation_tip: Advised using large clear ice cubes or ice spheres and garnish picks for elegance
assistant|collins_glass_endorsement: Endorsed the Collins glass choice as perfect for showcasing the drink's colors and garnishes
